description: Every \(A\)-definable tuple set is invariant under every structure automorphism fixing \(A\) pointwise.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Definability.definable_invariant.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] {α : Type u'} {A : Set M} {s : Set (α → M)} (hs : A.Definable L s) (g : L.Equiv M M)
  (hg : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Definability.Fixes (⇑g) A) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Definability.Invariant (⇑g) s
